flow_verified: Inventory items are loaded from the inventory table into the selector.
Selecting an item transfers its design ID and requested quantity to the order-slip form.
The order-slip form resolves the item name and price from the design ID.
Submitting the order slip saves the slip and updates inventory in the same transaction.
confirmed_business_rules: Users may continue when requested quantity exceeds available stock.
Negative quantities are allowed for flexible stock adjustments.
review_notes: Inventory selection currently displays TotalQuantity only. If opening stock is maintained separately, its display policy should be decided explicitly.
Closing the inventory selector should close only that window, not the full application.
Cancelled or reset order-slip forms should roll back and close their draft transaction.
